notes.title: Update 1 Fixes v1.02
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, we have heard your feedback![/b]

Here's a list of fixes to the top issues we're seeing from your reports.

[b]Added:[/b]

    - Continuous Rotation
    - Player Height Offset
    - Toggle Grab
    - Height Min-Max limit
    - "Language change" label at the top of the map in the lobby
    - Translations
    
[b]Changed:[/b]

    - Sticky to Toggle
    - Better Steer Toggle
    
[b]Fixed:[/b]

    - Steer Wheel Toggle support
    - Turkish no language characters
    - minor fixes for Toggle Grab
    - Rotations grab bug
    - When spawning a tool, change rotation type
    - Rabbit Jumping
    - Grabbing a tool after entering and leaving a vehicle is working correctly now 

Thanks for the the support and all of your valuable feedback <3

Best,
Ultimate VR Team
